summary: Check a move target without changing it
description: Admin only. Connects with a 10 second timeout and checks the version (MySQL 8.0, MariaDB 10.6, Postgres 13 or newer), that the database has no tables, that the user can create and drop a table, and that it is not the database in use. Errors carry a database.error.<code> message id: invalid-target, connect, timeout, version, not-empty, permission, same-database, env-locked.
